# EdNet simpleKT comparator for P05

Replay the earlier EdNet development split and its strict bundle completion rule. Use all 56,259 training, 8,025 tuning and 8,981 development answers. Hash buckets 80–99 stay unopened. Augment the same sixteen-event skill/answer history with the original item IDs. Select vocabularies on train only, map unseen IDs to zero. Fit the published simpleKT code with its item-difficulty vectors and a matched no-item-ID ablation using n_pid=0. Both use 64 dimensions, one block, four heads, 256 FFN and default output dimensions, .1 dropout, Adam .001, same seed and five epochs with tuning NLL checkpoint selection. The current answer sent to the model is always zero. A perturbation canary must show identical predictions when that placeholder becomes one. No padding inside the attention sequence. Compare the already frozen temporal candidate against these controls and the earlier clock-aware tree and SAKT on the same learner clusters. Use the earlier .015 nats per response margin and a 5,000-resample simultaneous interval across these four contrasts. Dev reused after model development. Primary claims require separate cohorts.
